newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle at $106/dressed, up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle at $106/dressed, up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was very active, with all buying concerns participating, USDA said.
Seller interest also excellent. Live sales fully $1.00 per cwt higher; with dressed sales $1.00-$2.00 higher.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs - 65.00- 66.00; dressed basis 106.00, instances 107.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 65.00- 66.00; dressed basis 106.00, instances 107.00. Confirmed - 12,000 For the week - 18,000
